description: Players with enchanted armour (#230): Frost Walker II boots freeze the water around players landing on the shore (replace_disk on onChangedBlock: frosted ice with its melting tick), Frost Walker boots make a player on a magma block immune to its damage, and a diver with a Respiration III helmet loses air more slowly (decreaseAirSupply, the player's random) than one without and drowns later.

actions.command: item replace entity walker armor.feet with minecraft:diamond_boots[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:frost_walker":2}]
item replace entity stepper armor.feet with minecraft:leather_boots[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:frost_walker":1}]
item replace entity diver armor.head with minecraft:diamond_helmet[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:respiration":3}]
item replace entity skater armor.feet with minecraft:iron_boots[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:frost_walker":1}]
